text_blocks.snippet: The ICD-10 code for uncontrolled type 2 diabetes is E11.65.

list.snippet: E11: This is the general code for type 2 diabetes mellitus.
.65: This modifier indicates that the diabetes is uncontrolled, specifically with hyperglycemia (high blood sugar levels).

text_blocks.snippet: Note: If the diabetes is uncontrolled due to hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels), the appropriate code would be E11.649.
